from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import pytest

import ralph

CLAUDE_LIMIT_LINE = "Claude usage limit reached. Your limit will reset at 8:30pm (America/Chicago)"


def reset_limits(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "agent_limited_until", {"claude": 0.0, "opencode": 0.0})


def test_parse_claude_reset_seconds_pm_time() -> None:
    tz = ZoneInfo("America/Chicago")
    now = datetime(2026, 6, 10, 18, 30, tzinfo=tz).timestamp()
    wait = ralph.parse_claude_reset_seconds(CLAUDE_LIMIT_LINE, now)
    assert wait == 2 * 3600


def test_parse_claude_reset_seconds_rolls_to_tomorrow() -> None:
    tz = ZoneInfo("America/Chicago")
    now = datetime(2026, 6, 10, 21, 30, tzinfo=tz).timestamp()
    wait = ralph.parse_claude_reset_seconds(CLAUDE_LIMIT_LINE, now)
    assert wait == 23 * 3600


def test_parse_claude_reset_seconds_hour_only_and_24h() -> None:
    tz = ZoneInfo("UTC")
    now = datetime(2026, 6, 10, 6, 0, tzinfo=tz).timestamp()
    line_hour = "Claude usage limit reached. Your limit will reset at 8am (UTC)"
    assert ralph.parse_claude_reset_seconds(line_hour, now) == 2 * 3600
    line_24h = "Claude usage limit reached. Your limit will reset at 20:30 (UTC)"
    assert ralph.parse_claude_reset_seconds(line_24h, now) == 14 * 3600 + 30 * 60


def test_parse_claude_reset_seconds_non_matching_line() -> None:
    assert ralph.parse_claude_reset_seconds("some other output", 0.0) is None


def test_parse_claude_reset_seconds_bad_timezone_falls_back_to_default() -> None:
    line = "Claude usage limit reached. Your limit will reset at 8:30pm (Mars/Olympus)"
    assert ralph.parse_claude_reset_seconds(line, 0.0) == ralph.DEFAULT_RATE_LIMIT_WAIT_SECONDS


def test_cli_agent_prefers_claude_then_opencode_then_none(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    reset_limits(monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "claude_mode_enabled", True)
    assert ralph.cli_agent() == "claude"
    ralph.mark_agent_limited("claude", 3600)
    assert ralph.cli_agent() == "opencode"
    ralph.mark_agent_limited("opencode", 3600)
    assert ralph.cli_agent() is None


def test_cli_agent_skips_claude_when_disabled(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    reset_limits(monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "claude_mode_enabled", False)
    assert ralph.cli_agent() == "opencode"
    ralph.mark_agent_limited("opencode", 3600)
    assert ralph.cli_agent() is None


def test_cli_agent_recovers_after_window_passes(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    reset_limits(monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "claude_mode_enabled", True)
    ralph.mark_agent_limited("claude", -1)
    assert ralph.cli_agent() == "claude"


def test_build_agent_command_falls_back_to_opencode_when_claude_limited(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    reset_limits(monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "claude_mode_enabled", True)
    ralph.mark_agent_limited("claude", 3600)
    command = ralph.build_agent_command("do the thing")
    assert command[0] == "opencode"


def test_handle_rate_limit_retries_when_smarter_agent_available(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    reset_limits(monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "claude_mode_enabled", True)
    ralph.mark_agent_limited("claude", 3600)
    handoffs: list[int] = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "rate_limit_handoff", lambda goal, wait: handoffs.append(wait))
    ralph.handle_rate_limit("goal")
    assert handoffs == []


def test_handle_rate_limit_hands_to_freebuff_until_earliest_reset(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    reset_limits(monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "claude_mode_enabled", True)
    ralph.mark_agent_limited("claude", 7200)
    ralph.mark_agent_limited("opencode", 3600)
    handoffs: list[int] = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "rate_limit_handoff", lambda goal, wait: handoffs.append(wait))
    ralph.handle_rate_limit("goal")
    assert len(handoffs) == 1
    assert 3590 <= handoffs[0] <= 3600


def test_handle_rate_limit_ignores_claude_deadline_when_disabled(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    reset_limits(monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "claude_mode_enabled", False)
    ralph.mark_agent_limited("opencode", 1800)
    handoffs: list[int] = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "rate_limit_handoff", lambda goal, wait: handoffs.append(wait))
    ralph.handle_rate_limit("goal")
    assert len(handoffs) == 1
    assert 1790 <= handoffs[0] <= 1800


def test_claude_limit_line_counts_as_rate_limited() -> None:
    assert ralph.looks_rate_limited(CLAUDE_LIMIT_LINE)
